definitions.explanation: The ratio of a building's footprint (the area it covers on the ground) to the total area of the plot, expressed as a percentage. A legal limit set by zoning that determines how much of a lot may be built on.

examples.japanese: この{土地|とち}の{建|けん}ぺい{率|りつ}は{六十|ろくじゅう}パーセントだ。
examples.english: The building coverage ratio for this lot is sixty percent.

examples.japanese: {建|けん}ぺい{率|りつ}を{超|こ}える{家|いえ}は{建|た}てられない。
examples.english: You can't build a house that exceeds the building coverage ratio.

examples.japanese: {地域|ちいき}によって{建|けん}ぺい{率|りつ}や{容積率|ようせきりつ}の{制限|せいげん}が{決|き}められている。
examples.english: Limits on the building coverage ratio and floor area ratio are set depending on the area.

notes:
A term from real estate and building regulation. It caps the ground area a building may occupy on its lot; the companion figure {容積率|ようせきりつ} caps total floor area. Sometimes written {建蔽率|けんぺいりつ} with the full kanji.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {建|けん}ぺい{率|りつ}を{超|こ}える: to exceed the building coverage ratio
- {建|けん}ぺい{率|りつ}{六十|ろくじゅう}パーセント: a coverage ratio of 60%
- {建|けん}ぺい{率|りつ}の{制限|せいげん}: coverage-ratio restrictions

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {容積率|ようせきりつ}: floor area ratio — total floor area relative to the lot, not just the footprint
